data.summary:
* Split 604-line submitToExecutionAgent.ts into an 88-line facade plus prepareSubmission, dispatchSubmission, announceInLinear, and types modules under domain/usecases/submitToExecutionAgent/.
  * Preserved the public function signature, DI shape, and all 63 existing tests; added 13 new tests (6 prepare + 7 dispatch + 1 facade) for the new modules.
  * Key decision: prepareSubmission throws on missing request fields per the Linear test-table spec; the facade wraps it in try/catch so the public Result contract is preserved.
  * Extracted announceInLinear helper shared by both dispatch paths, with caller-supplied log messages to retain distinct wording and avoid breaking existing log assertions.
  * `pnpm run ci:tracked` passes end-to-end (15,938 tests, typecheck, lint, static validation, build, format); PR #1938 opened against development.
